leadText:
Hoenn Pokérap is the third and final Pokérap made for . It was made for to feature the 135 .

This Pokérap also features and , both of whom were missing from their generation's respective Pokéraps. However, it does not include and . 

There are two versions. Both have the same lyrics, but one version has faster music and more rapping than the other.

It is available on the CD as Hoenn PokéRap along with four other songs from Pokémon: Battle Frontier. A remix of this song titled Hoenn PokéRap—Exclusive Remix! was included on the Exclusive Target Mix! CD. It was later used as the ending theme for Pikachu's Island Adventure under the title Hoenn Pokérap.

Unlike the previous Pokéraps, no official music video has been made for this rap. Several fans have made their own music video for this rap.

==Trivia==
and are mentioned in this rap despite having been released in previous generations. This may be due to their absence from their respective Pokéraps.
Unlike the two other raps, this one often covers similar or evolutionarily connected Pokémon to each other by singing one after the other.
If one was to rearrange the Pokérap so all of the Pokémon are in National Pokédex order, would remain in its position in the song. If one was to omit Mew and Celebi, as they are not Pokémon introduced in Generation III, and would remain in their respective spots upon rearrangement.
